__comment: DelightfulCompat: Ramadan Delight's small_dough is NOT in c:foods/dough (only FD's wheat_dough is), so it can't be used in Oaks/FD dough recipes. Add it here to unify dough. Merges with FD's c:foods/dough. NOTE: adding small_dough here makes ramadandelight:small_dough_from_dough a 1->2 duplication loop, which is why that recipe is disabled (see data/ramadandelight/recipe/small_dough_from_dough.json) and replaced with a cutting-board recipe.
